title: UDFA LB Taurean York has a legit shot at making the Broncos 53-man roster

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: UDFA LB Taurean York has a legit shot at making the Broncos 53-man roster
sources.description: At the conclusion of the 2026 NFL Draft, the Broncos signed several undrafted free agents, including Texas A&M linebacker Taurean York. He’s a talented player, but his lack of ideal size and length is a big reason why he went undrafted. However, the talent is there, and York has an opportunity to prove doubters wrong […]
